summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) to register Market Index Target-Term Securities (MITTS), unsecured senior notes linked to equity indices or ETFs. The filing establishes generic offering terms—no specific deal terms, pricing, or dates are stated. CIBC is the issuer; BofA Securities acts as agent. This is a routine shelf takedown of structured notes, not a special situation event.
